name: Error Notifier for Slack
author: Dhrumil Kumbhani

sections.description:
Error Notifier for Slack is a must-have plugin for WordPress site owners, developers, and administrators. It ensures you never miss a critical WordPress error by instantly sending alerts to your Slack channel using a webhook.

🚀 Why Use Error Notifier for Slack?

✔ Real-Time Error Monitoring – Get notified immediately when a WordPress error occurs.
✔ No Duplicate Alerts – Sends a single notification per error occurrence to prevent spam.
✔ Error Resolution Notifications – Get an alert when the error is resolved.
✔ Easy Slack Webhook Integration – Just enter your Slack webhook URL in the settings.
✔ Lightweight & Fast – Runs in the background without slowing down your site.
✔ No Coding Required – Simple UI for hassle-free setup.

Perfect for:
– Developers who need quick debugging insights.
– Site owners who want to prevent downtime.
– Agencies managing multiple WordPress sites.
sections.installation:
Follow these steps to install and configure Error Notifier for Slack:

  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Error Notifier and enter your Slack webhook URL.
  4. Save changes, and you’ll receive alerts when a critical error occurs!
sections.faq:
How do I set up Slack notifications?

Enter your Slack webhook URL in the plugin settings, and it will send alerts automatically.

Will this plugin send multiple notifications for the same error?

No. It sends only one notification per error until it’s resolved. Once fixed, a single “Error Resolved” alert is sent.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest WordPress version?

Yes! Error Notifier for Slack is tested with the latest WordPress versions to ensure smooth performance.

Does this plugin affect website speed?

Not at all! The plugin is lightweight and runs efficiently in the background.
